receiptsName.message: Feedprint - Save What Your Feed Showed You

receiptsDescription.message: A signed archive of what your feed showed on X, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, kept on your computer. Anyone can check it.

offName.message: Off - Hide Swearing, Likes, Reels, Shorts and Ads on Social Media

offDescription.message: Turn off swearing, slurs, like counts, Reels, Shorts and ads on Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok and YouTube. Free, no account.
